description: Immersive 3-day 2-night wellness retreat at Polperro Farmhouse, Red Hill. Incorporates yoga (outdoor in summer; studio in winter); massage (Peninsula Hot Springs Spa Dreaming Centre or Endota Red Hill); acupressure workshop ($300 group); and Peninsula juice cleanse ($55 pp/day). Set in Polperro's biodynamic vineyard estate with organic gardens. Organised in partnership with Hut Yoga.
bookingRequired: Yes — contact Polperro or Hut Yoga
priceRange: From approx AUD 1,500–2,000+pp (accommodation + programme; additional services extra)
recurrenceNote: Available on request (not fixed public dates)
suitableFor: Couples; solo travellers; wellness seekers; small groups
accessibilityNotes: Farmhouse accommodation accessible — check with venue
nearbyAttractions: Peninsula Hot Springs; Many Little restaurant (same estate); Flinders Truffles
suggestedItineraryPairing: Full Peninsula wellness immersion: arrive Fri; retreat Sat–Sun; depart Mon with farewell cellar door tasting
internalNotes: Contact Lauren at Polperro: (03) 5989 2871 Wed–Sun or email info@hutyoga.com.au. No fixed public dates — book direct. Pricing estimate based on available inclusions; confirm full pricing with Polperro.
